subject: 2551M (2002) page 1 item 6, the fourth (branch-code) group of the TIN comb chain: the printed box x 174.00-207.36, y 190.80-210.24 pt (top-left origin) in the pinned source 2551m.pdf sha256 f678be684558b8fb15a026b70a7c473f904fd07d49df64e0345fe1c0f81de71e. There is NO official field key for it in this checkout: rules/forms/ has no 2551m directory at all, so unlike 2550M this record cannot name a harvested field_key and does not pretend to. The cell id p1c19 is a HINT only: cell ids are quantised bounding boxes and renumber on any geometry change, so the printed box is what identifies the subject and the edit anchor below is what binds it to a batch.
what: The whole TIN strip — four groups plus the three separator boxes between them — keeps the same outer span 59.76-207.36 pt (147.6pt). Separator widths are unchanged (they only move). The remaining 133.48pt is split equally across 14 digit cells (3+3+3+5) by left(i)=round(i*width/14, 2). p1c13 left 59.76 width 28.6 (3 x 9.53, 9.54, 9.53); p1c15 left 93.16 width 28.61 (3 x 9.54, 9.53, 9.54); p1c17 left 126.29 width 28.6 (3 x 9.53, 9.53, 9.54); p1c19 left 159.69 width 47.67 (5 x 9.53, 9.54, 9.53, 9.54, 9.53). A white knockout covers that same outer rectangle so the official 3- or 4-cell artwork does not show through the new even cells. Each digit group keeps ONE outer 0.72pt frame; interior slot dividers are short bottom hairs (~33% of slot height), matching how the official sheet draws a charbox tick (2550M item-1 month v172 is 0.72×4.32pt in a 13.20pt box), not a full-height wall on every digit. Separator boxes keep their dedicated SVG fill and a 0.72pt black frame, and stay non-tabbable. The branch group p1c19 is five EDITABLE cells (one blank maxlength-1 input each, no value, no readonly), because the official artwork prints an EMPTY branch box — no 000, no ink of any kind inside it. Painting a locked 00000 over a blank official box would silently declare the head office on a sheet whose filer has to name a real branch. First/last writing-surface insets are not re-applied: even cell width across the strip is the layout rule. Branch pitch 9.53.
reason: BIR's 2002 artwork for 2551M is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. Measured from the pinned PDF, the branch box prints exactly two internal ticks, at x 184.80 and x 196.08, each 3.12pt tall at the foot of the box (y 206.16-209.28) and 0.72pt wide -- three compartments. Unlike 2550M, 2551M pre-prints NOTHING inside that box: three independent readers find zero glyphs and zero curve outlines strictly inside it, so there is no pre-printed '000' here and the emitted comb is the only thing a filer can type into. Today's full TIN is nine digits plus a FIVE-digit branch code, so three compartments cannot hold it. No rule can derive 'BIR widened this field after 2002' from 2002 ink, which is exactly why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug. Filing safety: a branch code is what tells the Bureau WHICH establishment a percentage-tax return belongs to. A filer whose branch code has four or five digits cannot enter it on today's form at all, so the return files against a truncated code -- and, because this box is blank rather than pre-printed, it can also be left empty entirely. Corpus context, measured from the pinned PDFs on 2026-08-08: of 53 bundles, 39 print 3+3+3+5, three print 3+3+3+3 (2550M, 2551M 2002, 2553 1999), one prints 3+3+3+4 (1600WP 2010) and ten are not measurable by that method. 2551M is not the only form in this class; it is the one corrected here, and the others each need their own record.
authority: User rule of 2026-08-15 that the only valid TIN format is 3-3-3-5; no harvested fields.json for 2551M exists in this checkout, and regulation not identified in-repo. This is a WEAKER authority than C01's and is deliberately recorded as such: C01 could quote BIR's own harvested runtime declaration (rules/forms/2550m-v2007/fields.json, frm2550m:txtBranchCode max_length 5), and for 2551M there is no such file to quote. rules/forms/ carries 43 form directories including the neighbours 2550m-v2007, 2551q-v2018, 2552-v2018 and 2553-v1999, and NO 2551m directory of any revision, so this record cites no field_key, no max_length and no source_ref for 2551M, because none exists here. NO BIR issuance is cited either: none could be identified from anything in this checkout that says when or under what authority the 2551M branch box was widened. The in-repo corroboration is a repo-authored guide, not an issuance about this form: docs/tax-profile/TIN_BRANCH_PROFILE_AND_FILING_GUIDE_2026-08-07.md records the current full display as 000-000-000-00000 with a five-digit branch suffix. Both gaps are stated deliberately rather than filled with a plausible-looking regulation number or a borrowed 2550M citation, and they stay visible until someone supplies the real ones.

Neither check may be allowlisted, excluded or waived to make this correction quiet, and no tolerance moves for it.
verified_by: An independent producer, sharing nothing with whatever writes the correction: the three printed compartments are re-derived from the pinned PDF by a reader that is not extract.py (re-derived while authoring this record by `mutool draw -F trace` and by Poppler `pdftocairo -svg`, both agreeing with PyMuPDF to 0.01pt on the box 174.00-207.36 and the two ticks 184.80 / 196.08, and all three finding no ink of any kind inside the box), and the five emitted compartments are re-derived from the written bytes by a parser that reads none of emit.py's markers. Not from build/layout, not from the IR, not from the applier's own manifest, and not from a determinism re-run -- that runs the writer twice and both halves drift together.
